- Workshop requested: dedicated sizing + SLA negotiation session (3-hour deep dive).
- Asked: 'Can you guarantee sustained 450 QPS for scheduled indexing windows without impacting chat SLOs?'
- Concern: procurement will require clear cost model for reserved GPUs vs burst. They want per-GPU cost + token/unit math.

- Routing: want policy to route by SLA tier (gold routes -> dedicated pool) and automatic fallback to quantized variants when burst.
- Quote request: include 3 sizing scenarios (conservative, expected, aggressive) and failure/fallback economics.
- Internal champion: VP Eng (Priya Nair). AE asked to join procurement meeting in week of 2026-06-02.
